messages:
Anna: Heads-up: Console team wants a tiny badge plus an expandable hint for client-visible failures. Can API expose a minimal, stable surface so SDK + Console show consistent wording?

Mike: Current signals are spread across HTTP codes (429, 503, 409) and some internal 5xx flavors. SDK today collapses many into a single transient error class, so Console can't reliably pick badge text.

Tao: Reminder: we also have 429 subcodes (burst vs budget) that the SDK ignores. We should avoid forcing clients to parse numeric subcodes.

Jen: Proposal: add a small, stable error contract in the response body: status_category (enum: throttle, degrade, quota, internal_fallback) and short_hint (max 120 chars). Optional badge_text (max 24 chars) for compact badge. Keep HTTP codes as-is for infra semantics.

Anna: UX constraints: do not leak internal names or IDs in short_hint or badge_text. Hints must be user facing and actionable, eg: Retry after 2s or reduce concurrency. No tenant ids or PII.

Mike: Implementation: many services only set HTTP code. We will add a gateway middleware that synthesizes status_category from routing metadata. Gate this behind a feature flag error_cat_v1 and deploy to canary first.

Tao: Telemetry: include status_category in trace spans and sample short_hint text for quality checking (1% free tier, 10% paid). Internal fields like route_variant go under x-internal.* and never surface to clients.

Jen: SDK behavior: if fields absent, SDK falls back to simple heuristics (status code + headers) and Console renders a generic Failure badge with tooltip Details unavailable - upgrade for richer hints. This keeps backwards compatibility.

Anna: CI/ security: add a linter to scan short_hint and badge_text for forbidden tokens (pool names, region ids). Initially warning in canary, then block on mainline after approval. Also strip nonprintables and enforce printable char whitelist.

Mike: Headers: do not expose internal headers to clients. Keep x-internal-* for logs only. No X-Redwood-Route-Fallback in public responses.

Jen: I will update SDK mapping table and add unit tests asserting no internal substrings appear in the UI.

deploy-bot: deploy success: error-cat-middleware v1 -> canary on prod-a :rocket:

Anna: We'll monitor sampled hints for 2 hours. If any sampled hint contains internal tokens we will rollback immediately. Sync after the canary window. End of thread.
